prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a production-ready transparent sprite atlas for the plsteach.me website. Use the attached image as exact character identity and material reference: burnt-orange soft pentagonal oversized head and forest-green soft rectangular oversized head, huge white oval eyes, dark green pupils, small white smile, rounded short limbs, matte clay 3D. ONE square transparent image in a strict 2x2 grid. FOUR COMPLETE DIFFERENT character poses, one in each quadrant, each fully within its cell with clear transparent padding on all sides. All characters face generally toward viewer.
TOP LEFT: ORANGE character STANDING AND WAVING, feet flat together, left hand up beside its head with friendly open rounded hand, other arm relaxed. Entire character, do not crop.
TOP RIGHT: GREEN character LEANING FORWARD OVER AN INVISIBLE HORIZONTAL LEDGE, head tilted with curiosity, chin above two hands resting next to each other along the same horizontal baseline. Only head, shoulders, forearms and two gripping hands visible, lower body hidden behind the invisible ledge. No ledge drawn. This is a playful peek over a website card.
BOTTOM LEFT: ORANGE character LYING RELAXED ON ITS SIDE, a clear horizontal silhouette, oversized head resting on one bent arm at left, torso and relaxed crossed legs extending right, other hand casually resting on hip. Head fully visible and looking toward viewer. Whole figure, no crop.
BOTTOM RIGHT: GREEN character SITTING CROSS-LEGGED, feet crossed in front with knees wide, hands resting on knees, upright oversized head. Whole figure, no crop.
Preserve character identity and the reference color palette precisely. All poses are visually and anatomically distinct, not four standing or four sitting figures. Keep generous 45px margins within each square cell, and equal head scale where possible. True alpha background including spaces between limbs; no floor, no shadows on a floor, no furniture, no objects, no text, no labels, no grid lines. Opaque white eyes. Clean cutout edges.
